title: lazy: load component code on demand

slides.text: Load it when you need it 📦
slides.say: Lazy lets you defer loading a component’s code until it renders for the first time.
Replace the static import with lazy and a dynamic import. Wrap it in Suspense to show a fallback while the code loads.

slides.text: The module must use a default export. React calls load only once and caches it.
slides.say: The lazy module must have a default export. React calls the load function only once and caches the result.
Always declare lazy components at the top level of your module. Inside a component, all state resets on re-renders.
